data.body: Fixed on main: change 1329 merged as 3f5880cea9 (a32a: normalize comment dedup key). _diff_comments now composes the local dedup key as codec.normalize_outbound(sanitizer.fit_comment(body)) — fit-then-normalize, the same order the send path (outbound_mapper.map_fields_to_remote) uses. AC evidence: (1) key computed from what send path produces — outbound_comments.py seam; (2) non-identity-codec property test — test_already_mirrored_comment_under_non_identity_codec_emits_no_add + test_new_comment_under_non_identity_codec_is_still_emitted (diffing/test_diff_comments_codec_normalization.py); (3) corpus idempotence — test_codec_aware_key_is_idempotent_over_realistic_bodies; (4) codec pinning — test_normalize_outbound_equals_decode_of_to_wire (test_rich_text_codec.py, parametrized over implementations); (5) no-origin-aware-gate dependency documented in outbound_comments.py docstring. Baseline no-codec behaviour covered by test_without_an_injected_codec_todays_baseline_behaviour_is_unchanged.
